WITH contacted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
sales AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted)),
rets AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, r.refund_net, r.refund_gross, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted))
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM contacted) contacted,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM sales) buyers,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM sales) net_all,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM sales WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) net_nostaff,
 (SELECT sum(gross_amount) FROM sales WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) gross_nostaff,
 (SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM rets) ret_all,
 (SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM rets WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) ret_nostaff,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM sales) lines

WITH contacted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19),
sales AS (
  SELECT sum(f.net_amount) AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted)),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sum(r.refund_net) AS v FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted))
SELECT 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name, 19 AS campaign_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM contacted) AS members_contacted,
  round((SELECT v FROM sales) - (SELECT v FROM refunds), 2) AS net_spend_eur
